title.en: the sint welcome at the houtdok, 15:00.
title.de: der sint wird am houtdok begrüßt, 15:00.

line.en: the sint and his helpers moor at the houtdok from 15:00, with a welcome song rehearsed beforehand. a slow walk down to the water, then back into the city.
line.de: der sint und seine helfer legen ab 15:00 am houtdok an, mit einem willkommenslied, das vorher geübt wird. ein ruhiger spaziergang zum wasser, danach zurück in die stadt.
line.tr: sint ve yardımcıları 15:00'ten itibaren houtdok'a yanaşıyor; karşılama şarkısı önceden çalışılıyor. suya doğru yavaş bir yürüyüş, sonra şehre dönüş.

sparks.why: The city of Gent (stad.gent, Sinterklaas komt naar Gent) says the sint moors at the Houtdok on Sunday 15 Nov 2026 from 15:00 with a welcome song.
